content.title: Meet the New Cast Members Joining the 'Malcolm in the Middle' Revival
content.text: ‘Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair’ is introducing a few new faces since the original show wrapped in 2006 Published on April 10, 2026 08:00AM EDT Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair. Credit : Disney/David Bukach NEED TO KNOW The Malcolm in the Middle revival, Life's Still Unfair, premiered on April 10 on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+Several new characters — including Malcolm's daughter, Leah, and his girlfriend, Tristan — joined the castMeanwhile, several roles have been recast The Wilkersons are expanding their clan. Malcolm (Frankie Muniz) and the rest of his chaotic family have officially returned in the new four-part event Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair. Picking up 20 years after the original series concluded, the revival sees the iconic dysfunctional group navigating life in the modern era. Nearly all of the original cast members have returned to reprise their roles, with Muniz playing Malcolm, Bryan Cranston reprising his role as Hal and Jane Kaczmarek appearing as Lois. Meanwhile, Christopher Masterson and Justin Berfield are also picking back up their roles as Francis and Reese, respectively. The series begins with Malcolm as a successful adult with a loving girlfriend, Tristan (Kiana Madeira) and teenage daughter, Leah (Keeley Karsten). The problem? He’s constructed this life completely in private, hiding it away from his family. But in the first episode, Hal and Lois barge into his house and discover his secret life, leading the group into their biggest misadventure yet. In addition to Malcolm's new family members, Life’s Still Unfair also welcomes a new Wilkerson — Kelly (Vaughan Murrae), Malcolm’s youngest sibling who is now a teenager. Here's everything to know about the new characters joining Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair. Keeley Karsten as Leah Keeley Karsten. Disney/David Bukach; Jon Kopaloff/Getty Karsten stars as Leah, Malcolm’s teenage daughter. Three days after giving birth, Leah’s mom, Dreamer, ran away, leaving Malcolm to raise her alone. Leah is the spitting image of Malcolm — highly intelligent and overly mature, leading her to become a social outcast. Before joining Malcolm in the Middle, Karsten held roles in films like The Fabelmans (2022) and Adult Best Friends (2024). She's also a part of the Apple TV+ drama The Savant alongside Jessica Chastain, which was postponed in September 2025. Kiana Madeira as Tristan Kiana Madeira. Hulu; Michael Loccisano/Getty Madeira stars as Tristan, Malcolm’s girlfriend. At the start of the series, Tristan and Malcolm are about to go through a major step in their relationship: meeting his daughter for the first time. But during her visit, Hal and Lois barge in, leading to an absolute disaster. On top of her role in Malcolm in the Middle, Madeira is best known for starring as Deena in the Fear Street franchise and for portraying Supergirl in the animated series My Adventures with Superman. Next up, she’s set to star in the horror movie Boiúna: Legend of the Amazon. Vaughan Murrae as Kelly Vaughn Murrae. Disney/David Bukach; Vaughan Murrae/Instagram Murrae stars as Kelly, Hal and Lois’ youngest child and the little sibling of Malcolm, Reese, Francis, Dewey, and Jamie. Kelly, who identifies as nonbinary, has personality traits of all their older brothers — they're intelligent and capable but a somewhat selfish trickster. Kelly also finds themselves in a heated rivalry with their brother, Reese. The two engage in a battle of who can ruin the other’s reputation more, leading to some classic Malcolm in the Middle hijinks. Murrae has also appeared in shows like The Solutioneers (2020-22) and The Way Home (2024-25). Caleb Ellsworth-Clark as Dewey Caleb Ellsworth-Clark. Disney/David Bukach; Kristina Bumphrey/Variety via Getty Caleb Ellsworth-Clark has taken over the role of Dewey, the family’s second-youngest son. Dewey is now a traveling musician and is only seen in the new series on Zoom calls. The character was originally played by Erik Per Sullivan, but he turned down reprising the role and has been retired from acting for over a decade. In an April 2026 interview with The Guardian, Kaczmarek said that Sullivan is now a graduate student at Harvard and declined returning to the show despite being offered “buckets of money.” Ellsworth-Clark has also held roles in shows like Wynonna Earp (2017) and Joe Pickett (2023). Next up, he’ll appear in Unspeakable: The Murder of JonBenet Ramsey along with Melissa McCarthy, Clive Owen and Alison Pill. Anthony Timpano as Jamie Anthony Timpano. Hulu, Jeremy Chan/Getty The role of Jamie has also been recast, this time being played by Anthony Timpano. In the original series, Jamie — the youngest brother who was born in season 4 — was played by brothers Lukas and James Rodriguez. In the revival series, Jamie now serves in the military. But when the family plans a special party for Hal and Lois' 40th anniversary, he decides to come home for a visit. Before taking over the role of Jamie, Timpano had guest spots on shows like Riverdale (2021) and Nancy Drew (2021).
